timeline.evidenceText: They took all the captives, and all the plunder, both of man and of animal.

definitions.full: H4455. malqowach I. מַלְקוֺחַ noun masculine Isa 49:25 booty, prey (compare לָקַח 9 ); — מ מִגִּבּוֺר ׳הֲיֻקַּח Isa 49:24 (|| שְׁבִי ), compare 49:25 (|| id. ); Num 31:26 (|| id. ), 31:11 (|| שָׁלָל ), 31:12 (|| id. + שְׁבִי , i.e. here, only, distinguished from captives), 31:32 (|| הַבָּ֔ז יֶתֶר ), 31:27 . II. [ מַלְקוֺחַ ] noun [masculine] jaw (as taking, seizing food); — dual suffix מַלְקוֺחָ֑י מֻדְבָּק וּלְשׁוֺנִי Psa 22:16 and my tongue is made to cleave to my jaws , i.e. my gums.
